Despite the reported "normal" spot protein/creatinine ratio (likely erroneous given other data), the clinical and laboratory picture fits nephrotic syndrome most consistent with membranous nephropathy.

[DIAGNOSIS] Membranous nephropathy (nephrotic syndrome)
